Metadata.title: BaliTrade
Metadata.description: B2B export marketplace — authentic products from Bali to Russia & CIS

Footer.tagline: Authentic products from Bali sellers, quality-checked and shipped to buyers in Russia & CIS.

HowItWorks.title: How BaliTrade works
HowItWorks.intro: BaliTrade sits between you and the seller in Bali: we check the goods, hold your payment and arrange the air cargo. Here is what happens from the moment you find a product.

s1.title: Find a product
s1.text: Browse products from Bali sellers and pick what you need.

s2.title: Discuss
s2.text: Chat with the seller and our team, and agree on the details.

s3.title: Pay securely
s3.text: Your payment is held by BaliTrade until your goods arrive.

s4.title: Quality check
s4.text: We inspect and send you a photo and video report to approve.

s5.title: Ship
s5.text: We pack and send by air cargo, and you can follow the tracking.

s6.title: Receive
s6.text: Confirm arrival, then the seller gets paid.

qc.title: Quality control
qc.text: We inspect goods and send you photos & videos before shipping.

payment.title: Protected payment
payment.text: Your money is held by BaliTrade and released to the seller only after delivery.

chat.title: Talk to everyone
chat.text: Every chat includes you, the seller and the BaliTrade team.

cargo.title: Door to airport
cargo.text: We handle packing, export documents from Bali and air cargo.

bank.title: Bank transfer (IDR)
bank.text: Transfer rupiah to our Indonesian bank account and upload the receipt. The amount is fixed at the exchange rate shown on your order.

usdt.title: USDT
usdt.text: Send USDT to our wallet, then submit the transaction hash together with a screenshot.

exchange.title: Through a partner exchange
exchange.text: If you can only pay in rubles, pay a partner exchange in Indonesia. They send the rupiah to BaliTrade and we match it to your order.

HowItWorks.paymentNote: The account details are shown on your order once it is ready to pay. Every payment is checked by our team by hand, and your money stays with BaliTrade until your goods arrive.

shipping.s1: We pack your goods in Bali after you approve the quality report.
shipping.s2: Shipping is billed separately once the real weight and carton count are known, so you never pay an estimate.
shipping.s3: Everything travels by air cargo to Russia and CIS countries.
shipping.s4: Our team adds each step to the tracking timeline on your order page.

q1.q: How does BaliTrade protect my payment?
q1.a: Your payment is held by BaliTrade until your goods arrive. The seller is paid only after you confirm delivery.

q2.q: What if the goods don’t pass quality control?
q2.a: We will first help you find a replacement. If you prefer, you can get a full refund.

q3.q: Can I order more than the stock shown?
q3.a: Yes. Ask the seller and BaliTrade in the product chat about a larger quantity. Made-to-order products have a lead time set by the seller.

q4.q: Which countries do you ship to?
q4.a: Russia and CIS countries, for example Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Armenia and Belarus. You only enter a delivery address; our team arranges the air cargo.

q5.a: Shipping time depends on the destination. Our team confirms it before you pay.

AdminCategories.title: Product categories
AdminCategories.intro: Categories decide what may be sold. Switching one off takes every listing in it out of the shop at once — buyers stop seeing it and its page answers "not found" — without changing the listings themselves, so switching it back on brings them all back. Archiving does the same to the shop and also takes the category out of this list — use it for a category you have retired, while its listings still point at it.
AdminCategories.slugHelper: Fixed for good once a listing uses it, so pick carefully. Capitals and underscores, e.g. {example}.
AdminCategories.sortOrderHelper: Lower numbers come first in the catalog and in the seller form.
